lines.text: Pisces, you fell for who they could be. Meet who they are.
lines.caption: meet who they are

lines.text: Pisces, the escape is beautiful. The life you're escaping still needs you.
lines.caption: come back

lines.text: Pisces, potential is not a person. It's a story you're telling.
lines.caption: potential is not a person

lines.text: Pisces, sleeping through the day won't make the hard part shorter.
lines.caption: wake up

lines.text: Pisces, rescuing them is not the same as being loved by them.
lines.caption: you are not the lifeguard

lines.text: Pisces, daydreams are a map. At some point you have to walk.
lines.caption: start walking

lines.text: Pisces, the daydream version of them never forgets to call.
lines.caption: the real one forgot

lines.text: Pisces, feeling everything is not a flaw. Drowning in it is optional.
lines.caption: drowning is optional

lines.text: Pisces, love should not feel like drowning politely.
lines.caption: come up for air

lines.text: Pisces, rescuing everyone leaves no hands left for you.
lines.caption: save one for you

lines.text: Pisces, blurry lines make blurry relationships.
lines.caption: draw the line

lines.text: Pisces, you cry at movies so you don't have to cry about your life.
lines.caption: the movie can wait

lines.text: Pisces, they showed you who they are. Believe the first draft.
lines.caption: believe the first draft

lines.text: Pisces, a little structure won't kill the magic. It will protect it.
lines.caption: structure protects it

lines.text: Pisces, being soft is not the same as being available for anything.
lines.caption: soft, not available

lines.text: Pisces, the world is loud. That doesn't mean you have to absorb all of it.
lines.caption: absorb less

lines.text: Pisces, the fantasy is safe because it can't leave you.
lines.caption: it can't leave you

lines.text: Pisces, the alarm went off three times. Life is calling.
lines.caption: life on line one

lines.text: Pisces, you write the whole love story before the second date.
lines.caption: it's only date two

lines.text: Pisces, imagination is a superpower when you finish what it starts.
lines.caption: finish what it starts

lines.text: Pisces, nobody can be loved into becoming who you need.
lines.caption: you can't love them into it

lines.text: Pisces, other people's feelings are not yours to carry home.
lines.caption: leave it at the door

lines.text: Pisces, absorbing their mood is not the same as understanding it.
lines.caption: that mood isn't yours

lines.text: Pisces, the dream needs one boring hour a day to become real.
lines.caption: the boring hour

lines.text: Pisces, the song makes it sound beautiful. The texts say otherwise.
lines.caption: read the texts

lines.text: Pisces, the tears are allowed. So is getting up after.
lines.caption: get up after

lines.text: Pisces, being needed by someone broken is not a love story.
lines.caption: not a love story

lines.text: Pisces, the dream world will still be there after you pay the bill.
lines.caption: pay the bill

lines.text: Pisces, a clear no is kinder than a dreamy maybe.
lines.caption: a clear no

lines.text: Pisces, too sensitive is what people say before they learn from you.
lines.caption: not too sensitive

lines.text: Pisces, a person who only shows up in your dreams is a dream.
lines.caption: real ones text back

lines.text: Pisces, saying yes to everyone is a quiet way of disappearing.
lines.caption: say no once

lines.text: Pisces, wanting someone who swims toward you is not asking too much.
lines.caption: swim toward me

lines.text: Pisces, a soft heart still needs a spine to hold it up.
lines.caption: grow the spine

lines.text: Pisces, the ex you romanticize was not that kind in real time.
lines.caption: it wasn't that kind

lines.text: Pisces, the clock keeps moving even when you're somewhere else.
lines.caption: come back to now

lines.text: Pisces, you feel their sadness before they speak. Let them speak anyway.
lines.caption: let them say it

lines.text: Pisces, escape is a vacation. Don't let it become your address.
lines.caption: not your address

lines.text: Pisces, what if the chemistry is just your imagination filling in blanks?
lines.caption: filling in blanks

lines.text: Pisces, what are you avoiding by staying in bed?
lines.caption: what is it

lines.text: Pisces, love that only lives at 2am might not survive daylight.
lines.caption: check it in daylight

lines.text: Pisces, your gift is seeing what isn't there yet. Now build some of it.
lines.caption: build some of it

lines.text: Pisces, they don't have to be wounded for you to care.
lines.caption: they don't need fixing

lines.text: Pisces, your intuition is right more often than you let it be.
lines.caption: trust it

lines.text: Pisces, losing yourself in someone is still losing yourself.
lines.caption: still losing yourself

lines.text: Pisces, the art only counts if someone gets to see it.
lines.caption: show someone

lines.text: Pisces, the signs were there. You painted over them.
lines.caption: you painted over it

lines.text: Pisces, it's not too late. It's just later than the dream said.
lines.caption: not too late

lines.text: Pisces, being chosen should feel clear, not like a riddle.
lines.caption: not a riddle

lines.text: Pisces, saving others is easier than saving an afternoon for yourself.
lines.caption: save the afternoon

lines.text: Pisces, a slow, steady person can feel boring. Stay a while and see.
lines.caption: boring is safe

lines.text: Pisces, other worlds are easy for you. This one needs you at the table.
lines.caption: pull up a chair

lines.text: Pisces, forgiving everything is not the same as being loved.
lines.caption: not everything

lines.caption: choose the current

lines.caption: stay for the film

lines.text: Pisces, money is not a dirty word for dreamers.
lines.caption: dreamers pay rent

lines.text: Pisces, you call it destiny when it is really just loneliness at night.
lines.caption: just a lonely night

lines.text: Pisces, the quiet you crave is not out there. Turn something off.
lines.caption: turn it off

lines.text: Pisces, love the dreamer in you. Then date someone awake.
lines.caption: date someone awake

lines.text: Pisces, you were never too much. You were just in the wrong water.
lines.caption: the wrong water

lines.text: Pisces, if only you can see the future together, it's a daydream for one.
lines.caption: a daydream for one

lines.text: Pisces, a dealbreaker isn't mean. It saves you both a year of hoping.
lines.caption: a year of hoping

lines.text: Pisces, release them gently, but do it out loud. Fading is not kinder.
lines.caption: out loud

lines.text: Pisces, tell them the real you, not the dreamy one. The real one is better.
lines.caption: the real one

lines.text: Pisces, you build a whole story from one photo. Meet the person before the picture.
lines.caption: before the picture

lines.text: Pisces, stop rewriting the old ending. A new deal comes at 11:11.
lines.caption: stop rewriting it

lines.text: Pisces, you feel everyone's weather. Find the few who feel yours back.
lines.caption: who feels yours

lines.text: Pisces, your Venus shows how you love. Check it before you rescue someone again.
lines.caption: not a rescue

lines.text: Pisces, tell yourself the truth before you tell yourself the story.
lines.caption: truth before story

lines.text: Pisces, you can release a dream without failing it. Some were only for sleeping.
lines.caption: only for sleeping
